title: Implement Timed Turbo and Ghost Turds
objective: Add validated normal/turbo/ghost toilet data, two explicit refreshable player effects, active-effect HUD feedback, Ghost hazard composition, and a completable restroom_006 demonstration while preserving all accepted collection, door, hazard, movement, and exit behavior.
acceptance: legacy toilets normalize to normal; only normal, turbo, and ghost are accepted; Turbo duration/value and Ghost duration validate strictly and malformed values fail closed
special turds retain existing construction, targeting, pickup animation, and one-shot collection but are clearly distinguishable with warm Turbo and spectral Ghost emissive materials

every special collection increments the ordinary objective exactly once, evaluates doors and final exit immediately, then activates its effect; duplicates change no objective, trigger, effect, or feedback state
BurglarPlayer owns only explicit Turbo and Ghost timers; Turbo applies the configured multiplier to effective baseline speed, Ghost exposes temporary hazard immunity, and restart starts clean
same-type collection refreshes duration without stacking magnitude; Turbo and Ghost coexist with independent timers; expiry removes HUD entries and restores exact baseline state
Ghost suppresses only the reset consequence for legitimate reset_zone entry, emits deterministic evidence, and normal reset resumes after expiry and re-entry without disabling the hazard
a normal hazard reset preserves active Turbo and its decreasing remaining duration while preserving all TB-R07 objective/door/toilet/exit state
the active-effect HUD displays HOT SHIT and GHOST TURD only while active with readable changing time and does not redesign existing HUD feedback

restroom_006 has 8-10 collectibles including at least five normal, two Turbo, and two Ghost, 2-3 empty toilets, exactly two doors/triggers, at least two hazards, three areas, optional advantages, safe routes, and no soft lock
TB-001, TB-002, TB-003, TB-H01, TB-R01, TB-R02, TB-R03, TB-R03A, TB-R04 identity, TB-R04B, TB-R04C, TB-R05, TB-R06, TB-R07, and TB-R08 pass individually
Godot validation, nine special-turd evidence screenshots, Linux x86_64 export, and exported runtime self-test of restroom_001 through restroom_006 all pass
tests, prior levels, character, baseline movement/gait/camera/collision, existing door/pickup/hazard authority, audio, assets, inventory, generic effects, and unrelated gameplay do not change
